post.originalText:
i asked Gemini 4 argon to “ make me a stimulations of the earth realistic  with blender with the moon orbiting the around the  earth add notable land marks and the ISS orbiting it too make it realistic as possible"

it took about 1hr 32min and cost about $90 made some corrections for better result  

i could not compare with opus i am almost out of weekly usage 😭( can afford to run out mid week ) 

but so far its good at 3d but not opus level yet but as good as astra 

it for well with building the earth and moon but not the best at details ( the land mark were not impressive )

but overall Gemini 4 argon is a cook not
